# Matrix Automotriz

> Neighborhood auto repair based in Austin, Texas. Straight answers, fair prices and a clear explanation before any work starts. The East Austin shop people send their friends to for a second opinion.

- Phone: (512) 385-7004
- Based in: Austin, TX
- Service area: East Austin, Govalle, Holly, East Cesar Chavez, Cherrywood, Downtown Austin
- Google rating: 4.7 from 53 reviews
- Request a quote: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/auto-repair/texas/matrix-automotriz/quote.html
- Book a drop-off: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/auto-repair/texas/matrix-automotriz/book.html

## Services
- Second opinions & inspections: Got a big repair quote somewhere else? Bring it by. We put the car up, show you what we see, and tell you straight whether the work is really needed.
- Computer analysis & diagnostics: Check-engine light on or something just feels off? Computer analysis to find the real problem before any parts get replaced.
- Brakes: Squeaking, grinding or a soft pedal. We check pads, rotors and fluid and tell you honestly how much life is left.
- Tune-ups & oil changes: Regular maintenance that keeps your car running right, done by people who know the car is how you get to work.
- Struts, shocks & alignment: Computerized alignment and balancing (alineación y balanceo computarizado), plus struts and shocks for a car that rides and tracks straight.
- Electrical service: Electrical problems tracked down with computer analysis. And if a job is better handled by a specialist, we'll tell you and point you to one.

## About
Matrix Automotriz is a neighborhood auto repair shop at 3228 E 5th St in East Austin. Look for the light-blue building with the red signs and the hand-painted Matrix sign over the bays. Customers have been writing about the shop for more than a decade, and the same things keep coming up: honest second opinions, fair prices, and quick work when you're stuck. When a job is outside what we do, we say so and send you to someone who can help. The signs on the wall say what we do: electrical service, computer analysis, tune-ups, oil changes, brakes, struts and shocks, plus computerized alignment and balancing.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: Can I bring my car in for a second opinion?
  A: Yes. A lot of our customers first come in with a quote from another shop. We'll inspect the car, show you what we find, and tell you honestly whether the work is needed.
- Q: Will I know the cost before you start?
  A: Yes. We go over what the car needs and what it will cost before any work begins. Customers tell us we even call about the cost of each part first.
- Q: Can you fix my car the same day?
  A: Often, yes, depending on the repair and parts. One customer's truck broke down while he was in town for a single day, and it was back on the road in a few hours. Call ahead and tell us what's going on.
- Q: Where are you and when are you open?
  A: 3228 E 5th St, Austin, TX 78702, in the light-blue building with the red signs. Monday to Friday 9 AM to 5:30 PM, Saturday 10 AM to 2 PM, closed Sunday.
- Q: What if my car needs something you don't do?
  A: We'll tell you straight and point you to a shop that does that kind of work, rather than take a job we shouldn't.
